youtube_title: Free Government Lawyer: Every Woman and Child Can Get One. Rules You Didn't Know #19 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #19. No money for a lawyer, so no justice? Who gets a free government lawyer? A: only the poor. B: every woman and child too, whatever the income?
Answer: B. Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act 1987: women, children, SC/ST members, persons with disabilities, people in custody, victims of trafficking or disasters, industrial workers, and people below the state's income limit (e.g. Rs 3 lakh a year in Delhi) get free legal aid. It covers the lawyer, court fee and case expenses. Go to the Legal Services Authority office at your district court or call the NALSA helpline 15100.
Sources: NALSA (eligibility); Legal Services Authorities Act 1987, s.12.
